title: Text 4
subtitle: 美国邮政的生存困境与改革

sentences.en: The U.S. Postal Service (USPS) continues to bleed red ink.
sentences.zh: 美国邮政管理局（USPS）持续亏损。

sentences.en: It reported a net loss of $5.6 billion for fiscal 2016, the 10th straight year its expenses have exceeded revenue.
sentences.zh: 它报告称2016财年净亏损56亿美元，这是其支出连续第十年超过收入。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, it has more than $120 billion in unfunded liabilities, mostly for employee health and retirement costs.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，它有超过1200亿美元的资金缺口，主要用于员工医疗和退休福利。

sentences.en: There are many reasons this formerly stable federal institution finds itself on the verge of bankruptcy.
sentences.zh: 这个曾经稳定的联邦机构何以濒临破产，原因有很多。

sentences.en: Fundamentally, the USPS is in a historic squeeze between technological change that has permanently decreased demand for its bread-and-butter product, first-class mail, and a regulatory structure that denies management the flexibility to adjust its operations to the new reality.
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，USPS正处于一个历史性的困境之中：一方面，技术变革永久性地降低了对它的主打产品——一类邮件——的需求；另一方面，监管结构使管理层无法灵活调整运营以适应新的现实。

sentences.en: And interest groups ranging from postal unions to greeting-card makers exert self- interested pressure on the USPS's ultimate overseer — Congress — insisting that whatever else happens to the Postal Service, aspects of the status quo they depend on get protected.
sentences.zh: 从邮政工会到贺卡制造商等各种利益集团，都出于自身利益向USPS的最终监管者——国会——施压，坚持认为无论邮政服务发生什么变化，他们赖以生存的现状的某些方面都必须得到保护。

sentences.en: This is why repeated attempts at reform legislation have failed in recent years, leaving the Postal Service unable to pay its bills except by deferring vital modernization.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么近年来多次改革立法的尝试都以失败告终，导致邮政服务除了推迟至关重要的现代化进程外，别无他法支付账单。

sentences.en: Now comes word that everyone involved — Democrats, Republicans, the Postal Service, the unions and the system's heaviest users — has finally agreed on a plan to fix the system.
sentences.zh: 现在有消息称，所有相关各方——民主党人、共和党人、邮政服务、工会以及该系统最重要的用户——终于就修复该系统的计划达成了一致。

sentences.en: Legislation is moving through the House that would save USPS an estimated $28.6 billion over five years, which could help pay for new vehicles, among other survival measures.
sentences.zh: 众议院正在审议一项立法，该立法将在五年内为USPS节省约286亿美元，这笔资金除用于其他求存措施外，还可用于购置新车辆。

sentences.en: Most of the money would come from a penny-per-letter permanent rate increase and from shifting postal retirees into Medicare.
sentences.zh: 大部分资金将来自每封信一美分的永久性资费上调，以及将邮政退休人员转入联邦医疗保险（Medicare）。

sentences.en: The latter step would largely offset the financial burden of annually pre-funding retiree health care, thus addressing a long-standing complaint by the USPS and its unions.
sentences.zh: 后一举措将在很大程度上抵消每年为退休人员医疗保健预先拨款的财务负担，从而解决USPS及其工会长期以来的不满。

sentences.en: If it clears the House, this measure would still have to get through the Senate — where someone is bound to point out that it amounts to the bare, bare minimum necessary to keep the Postal Service afloat, not comprehensive reform.
sentences.zh: 即使这项措施在众议院获得通过，它仍必须获得参议院的批准——在那里必定会有人指出，这仅仅是维持邮政服务运转所需的最低、最低限度的举措，而非全面改革。

sentences.en: There's no change to collective bargaining at the USPS, a major omission considering that personnel accounts for 80 percent of the agency's costs.
sentences.zh: 该方案没有对USPS的集体谈判制度作出任何改变，考虑到人事成本占该机构总成本的80%，这是一个重大疏漏。

sentences.en: Also missing is any discussion of eliminating Saturday letter delivery.
sentences.zh: 同样缺失的还有关于取消周六信件投递的任何讨论。

sentences.en: That common-sense change enjoys wide public support and would save the USPS $2 billion per year.
sentences.zh: 这一常识性的变革措施得到公众的广泛支持，每年可为USPS节省20亿美元。

sentences.en: But postal special-interest groups seem to have killed it, at least in the House.
sentences.zh: 但邮政业的特殊利益集团似乎已经扼杀了这一措施，至少在众议院是如此。

sentences.en: The emerging consensus around the bill is a sign that legislators are getting frightened about a politically embarrassing short-term collapse at the USPS.
sentences.zh: 围绕该法案正在形成的共识表明，议员们开始担心USPS出现政治上令人难堪的短期崩溃。

sentences.en: It is not, however, a sign that they're getting serious about transforming the postal system for the 21st century.
sentences.zh: 然而，这并不意味着他们开始认真对待为21世纪改造邮政系统这件事。

questions.stem: The financial problem with the USPS is caused partly by ____
questions.analysis: 根据题干判断本题考查因果细节。第一段的前三句都是有关USPS的具体数字，属于细节信息。第四句出现many reasons很多原因。紧接着下面就有fundamentally根本原因是， 所以定位在第一段的最后一句。然后分析这个长难句，USPS 处在squeeze between 1 and 2，中，1是technological change， 2是structure。 2的structure后定语从句：denies management flexibility 对应选项B： rigid management。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 2, the USPS fails to modernize itself due to ____

options.C: the shrinking demand for postal service.

questions.analysis: 根据题干due to，判断本题考查因果细节。根据题干关键词：USPS fails to modernize 定位到原文第二段最后一句，在这句前leaving，留下，导致这个结果，往前找原因，前一句提到reform legislation， 而且这句前还有this is why，只要找到代词this指代就可以判断选项。代词往前推，根据这句主干interest groups exerts pressure on Congress选择选项A，interference 对应 exert pressure on。

questions.stem: The long-standing complaint by the USPS and its unions can be addressed by ____

options.A: removing its burden of retiree health care.
options.B: making more investment in new vehicles.

questions.analysis: 因果细节题。根据38题题干The long-standing complaint by the 。。。。回文定位到第3段，最后一句：“ The latter step would largely offset the financial burden of annually pre-funding retiree health care， thus。。。。” 。再根据题干中“ can be addressed by” 即：通过哪种方式解决，此处为解题要点，通过哪种方式来解决，前后明显为结果与途径的关系，即可理解为因果关系。文章此句后半句正是题干，thus前半句为答案The latter step would largely offset the financial burden of annually pre-funding retiree health care。与 A。 B 。 C 。D 四个选项匹配后，正确答案为 A removing its burden of retiree health care。

questions.stem: In the last paragraph, the author seems to view legislators with ____
questions.analysis: 根据题干可以判断本题为观点态度题。回文定位到最后一段。题干“the author seems to view legislators with”， 具体定位到最后一段倒数第2句：“ The emerging。。。。。is a sign that legislators are getting frightened。。。。。。。” 再根据题干，问作者最终态度，本段最后一句，转折句是作者最终的态度：“ It is not， however， a sign that they’re getting serious about。。。。” ， 即作者认为他们并没有认真对待。所以此处作者态度为否定。匹配A B C D 四个选项 只有C discontent（ 不满）为负向信息，所以为正确答案。

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?

options.A: The USPS Starts to Miss Its Good Old Days
options.B: The Postal Service: Keep Away from My Cheese
options.C: The USPS: Chronic Illness Requires a Quick Cure
options.D: The Postal Service Needs More than a Band-Aid

questions.analysis: 根据题干特征词“best title”，这是一道主旨题。根据前四道题问的主题，第一道题和第二道题是USPS出现了问题，并分析原因，第三道题给出解决方法，第四道题提到作者对于这个方法的态度，即提出问题—分析问题—解决问题，并在最后给出作者对这个解决方案的评价。根据这个文章框架，首先A选项“USPS开始错过了它的好时光”，这只是提出问题，相对片面；B选项“USPS：不要动我的奶酪”， 这是拒绝解决问题的态度，不符合文章的写作思路；C选项“USPS：慢性病需要快方法”，这个chronic和quick都没有在文中提到；D选项“USPS需要的不仅仅是权宜之计”，这说的其实作者对于解决方案的评价，在文章最后一段。这段最后结尾有But，有however， “it[指代前文讲的方法] is not a sign……”，对此作者表示否定态度。所以D选项为正确答案。
